messages:
sam-eng: starting int2+fp8 bring-up for orion-70k. quick smoke showed drift after ~12k tokens when we do prefill+streaming. dumping kvcache now. anyone seen index/offset skew with new quant path?

maria-ml: hm, int2_fp8 path touched the kernel that applies rotary scaling. did we move the scale op after quantize? that can shift rope indices subtly.

sam-eng: good call. repro command i'm using:```
./run_kv_stitcher --model orion-70k --quant int2_fp8 --seq 12800 --prefill-file tests/longprefill.txt --dump-kv /tmp/kvdump.npz
```

jordan-research: can you paste a tiny excerpt of the kvdump header/log (no PII)? curious about shard boundaries and base offsets.

sam-eng: paste from /tmp/kvdump.npz header:```
KV-DUMP v1
model: orion-70k
quant: int2_fp8
seq_len: 12800
shard_size: 4096
window_base: 8192
index_map: 0..12799 mapped to kv slots 8192..8191 (wrap)
```

kvcache-bot: kv-checksum: FAIL at slot 12288 expected=0x3a4f got=0x3a5f (detected during stitch phase)

maria-ml: that index_map line looks suspicious - "8192..8191 (wrap)" indicates wrap logic returned empty range. maybe clamp logic around modulo is off by one when prefill_length % shard_size == 0.

natalie-qa: on a related branch i hit a reproducible off-by-one when system prompt + prefill pushes the first streaming token to the next shard boundary. quick test: reduce prefill by 1 token and drift disappears.

maria-ml: hypothesis: quant path reorders ops so RoPE scale factor is applied after a pack/unpack that uses different index arithmetic for wrapped windows. two quick checks: 1) run with --apply-rope-before-quant, 2) run kvcache-checker with stricter boundary clamps.

sam-eng: tried --apply-rope-before-quant, reduced checksum failures to 1/10 runs vs 8/10. attaching minimal repro (small log):```
[2026-03-22T16:03:01Z] run start, seed=42
[2026-03-22T16:03:05Z] prefill=8192 tokens
[2026-03-22T16:03:07Z] streaming start
[2026-03-22T16:03:09Z] stitch: expected_slot=12288 actual_slot=12289
```

jordan-research: thanks. can you run `stitcher-check --window-size 16384 --shard-size 4096 --dump-index` and drop the output? i'll run a bisect on the kernel.

sam-eng: running now, will paste when done.

kvcache-bot: stitcher-check output: boundary_clamp=disabled -> recommended=enabled; anomalies=3; first_anom_slot=12288

natalie-qa: short-term mitigation: enable clamp to floor(window_base / shard_size) * shard_size before mapping. i can PR the clamp in the stitcher util. will push small patch and run 1000-run smoke.

maria-ml: also add an assertion in the quant path: assert(index_map.size == seq_len) to catch future silent wraps.

sam-eng: patch PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4823 (dev branch) - applied clamp + assertion. quick smoke 10 runs -> 0/10 checksum fails. leaving full 1k run for QA. :thumbsup:

natalie-qa: running 1k now, will report if any regressions. if green, let's backport to canary. :eyes:

jordan-research: i'll still bisect kernel reorder; but this is a good mitigation. thanks y'all.

sam-eng: thanks — will keep thread updated. if QA finds anything, ping here or @maria-ml for triage.
